Elaine K: Quick vendor question — MeterWave trial invoice MW-INV-34872 shows negative trial credits then a large overage line. Anyone else hit this during pilot? cc @Samir P @Mike F
Samir P: Yep, noticed it yesterday. Looks like their trial credits are applied per-project, but our billing exports aggregate at org-level so it doubled up for some routes. I pinged MeterWave.
MeterWave Rep: Hi everyone — sorry for the confusion. We received the inquiry. Can you share the invoice id and a small export snippet so we can trace which project mapping caused the double application?
Elaine K: Invoice MW-INV-34872 (attached to original thread). Minimal export snippet for the affected lines: ```account,sku,quantity,unit_price,amount
redwood-prod,embeddings_tokens,120000000,0.0001,12000.00
redwood-prod,trial_credit,-,,-10000.00
redwood-test,embeddings_tokens,5000000,0.0001,500.00
```
MeterWave Rep: Thanks — I see the issue. Our trial-credit logic applied a project-level credit and an org-level promotion in parallel during trial mode; also we rounded token buckets to nearest 1k which explains the ~2k delta. We'll produce a corrected invoice or a reconciliation credit. For committed pricing: we can offer $0.00008/token on a 6-month commit and include a one-time onboarding credit.
Mike F: From finance side — we need a reconciled export broken down by date, project, route (hosted vs dedicated), model name, tokens, and charge. Format request: date,project,route,model,tokens,charge. Also we need the corrected invoice PDF and reconciliation delta line items for audit.
Procurement Bot: Reminder: any pilot credits or vendor concessions > $5k require procurement review and approval. @Elaine K please open PR-458 with the business case and expected commit.
Samir P: Also request they add a billing-dispute SLA in contract: 30 days to resolve disputes and either apply credit or issue a corrected invoice. That should avoid our current back-and-forth.
MeterWave Rep: Understood. Our standard term is 45 days; happy to edit to 30 days for Redwood and include per-route breakout exports. We'll prepare: (1) MW-INV-34872-REV1 corrected invoice, (2) CSV export with the requested cols, (3) draft contract amendment with 30-day dispute resolution and a rate-lock during the initial 6-month commit.
Elaine K: Sounds good. @Mike F can you draft the PO for the 6-month commit option and include expected monthly token window so vendor can calculate final credits? I'll attach the usage baselines.
Mike F: On it — drafting PO and attaching a usage baseline (approx 130M tokens/month). Will circulate by EOD. Also creating accounting ticket to track the credit when posted.
billing-bot: invoice MW-INV-34872-REV1 has been issued by MeterWave and is available in vendor-billing.
Samir P: :thumbsup: Thanks all — once we have the csv and revised invoice let's confirm the net delta and whether the commit pricing makes sense vs our internal cost model.
MeterWave Rep: We'll push the CSV and revised invoice within 24 hours, and a redline for the SLA term. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.
Elaine K: Prefer a quick 15m call after we review their CSV. I'll schedule if needed. Thanks everyone!
